title: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive — June 2016–2025, Zinal (46.1343 N, 7.6287 E)
claims: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive for the grid cell at 46.1343 N, 7.6287 E, elevation 1,640 m, over the 300 June days from 2016 to 2025: mean daily maximum 18.0 °C and mean daily minimum 6.6 °C.
The same query gives mean precipitation of 5.7 mm per day; 193 of the 300 June days (64.3%) had at least 1 mm.
Zinal village is still below the 2,424 m course high point, so these reanalysis statistics are the highest reliable station used on this page, not course-wide or summit data.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直接查询 Open-Meteo archive API；坐标与海拔取自 Open-Meteo geocoding 的 Zinal 村（46.13426, 7.62868, 1,640 m）；取 2016–2025 年 6 月共 300 天，按 daily time 过滤 06 月后计算均值。

claimVerification.note: API 返回 300 个 6 月日值；temperature_2m_max 均值 18.0，temperature_2m_min 均值 6.6。
precipitation_sum 均值 5.7 mm/day；≥1 mm 的日数 193/300 = 64.3%。
Zinal 村 1,640 m；赛道最高点 2,424 m 由官方赛道资料给出，本页明确不把村站数据外推到高点。
